Saved into AstraLabs: 2026-10-03

Purpose:
- Internal app-development and integration research.
- Observe and document authorized app/web API flows.

Rules:
- Keep the upstream MIT LICENSE intact.

Update policy:

- Review upstream changes first, then intentionally refresh this pinned snapshot.
